text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How unyielding—and how cold—are the chains 
of fate. However, things will not go this 
way in the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my Trainer's utmost efforts, my 
legs are right as rain! Even after 
grappling with the Goddess of Fate, I 
remain unbroken!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet, voices of unease and fear echo 
through the mortal realm. Dregs are 
inevitable in fine wine, but quite 
tasteless at a banquet. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall hold a public training session! 
Demonstrating my fine form should serve as 
good prevention against the public 
intoxicating itself with hype.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I've shown the entire world. That 
there's no issue with a forced march to 
the Nippon Derby!
